TASK_RECONCILIATION.TASK: No legacy DRS binary payload is required; runtime injects 16-byte tier minimums via GenerateEmergencyMockLimits.
Owned DRS files contain zero Screen.SetResolution calls; render scale uses DynamicResolutionHandler, URP renderScale fallback, and ScalableBufferManager.
DrsStateDTO uses public fields only. Runtime read access is ref readonly; job mutation uses UnsafeUtility.AsRef on vault pointers.
Primary DTO is 16 B. ResolutionScaleState is explicit 64 B. DrsTelemetryEntry is explicit 48 B and 8-byte aligned.
MockQualityWeightSignal is 16 B and MockQualityWeightDropJob forces a 0.2 target path without waiting on live Agent 44 state.
Policy scale is math.lerp(minScaleLimit, 1.0, GlobalQualityWeight), target/current motion uses exponential alpha 1-exp(-smoothing*dt), then pixel-grid stabilization prevents sub-pixel crawl.
Current scale is committed through DynamicResolutionHandler system scaler; fallback writes URP renderScale only when epsilon-gated.
Sharpen is a polynomial/inverse TAA curve: Smooth01(linear deficit) lerped toward normalized inverse deficit and damped by GlobalQualityWeight.
beginCameraRendering allows dynamic resolution only for Game/Base/world cameras; UI-only, overlay, and targetTexture cameras remain native.
_H8DrsMipBias is log2(1/currentScale) and epsilon-gated.
Low/mobile/no-compute resolves BLTA; high/ultra compute-capable path can resolve FSRT.
_H8DrsScreenPixelDimensions publishes native width/height and scaled internal dimensions.
No double3 or world-coordinate payload enters the DRS solver. DRS state is screen-space floats, uints, and bytes.
Frame EWMA >=33 ms or pressure >=3 bypasses smoothing and drops to the tier minimum.
_H8DrsHeavyPostProcessWeight fades heavy post with a guarded continuous ratio around the post-cull scale.
Exactly one DrsStateDTO vault element is allocated with NativeArrayOptions.UninitializedMemory.
300-entry DrsTelemetryEntry ring tracks scale, upscaler compute estimate, frame pressure, and dumps Dump_DRS_SURGEON.bin on invalid math.
Dynamic Resolution Tuner exposes min scale, smoothing, sharpening, mock weight, CSV load, and live readout.
Runtime parser consumes ReadOnlySpan<char> and hashes keys without Split/LINQ.
Editor oscilloscope draws 300 current/target/stress samples from the fixed telemetry ring.

ResolutionScaleState.Offsets: 0 current, 4 target, 8 stress, 12 stressEwma, 16 frameTime, 20 sharpen, 24 frame, 28 sequence, 32-35 bytes, 36 reserved, 40 visualOverkill, 44 dearLie, 48 flags, 52 GlobalQualityWeight, 56 reserved5, 60 reserved6.
ResolutionScaleState.Math: 64 bytes exactly one L1 cache line. No atomic counter sharing is introduced.

DrsTelemetryEntry.Offsets: 0 frame, 4 current, 8 target, 12 frameTime, 16 stress, 20 stressEwma, 24 sharpen, 28 flags, 32 sequence, 36 pressure, 37 thermal, 38 stp, 39 aup, 40 hysteresis, 42 framesBelowTarget, 44 upscalerMsBits.
DrsTelemetryEntry.Math: 48 is divisible by 8; explicit layout avoids ARM64 unaligned traps.

SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE_EXPLANATION: When GlobalQualityWeight drops below 0.3, TargetRenderScale collapses continuously through math.lerp toward the tier minimum, stress/thermal pressure lerps it further toward survival scale, and heavy post-process weight fades toward zero. The current scale still follows EWMA unless panic conditions trip; after EWMA it snaps to a 2-pixel dominant-axis grid so URP receives stable internal dimensions instead of sub-pixel drift. Visual overkill shader weights collapse through polynomial Smooth01 gates and math.step flags, while the Dear Lie/TAA sharpen curve increases reconstruction only as much as the pixel deficit requires.
SELF_AUDIT.H_PHI_VAULT_STATUS: Runtime declares zero private NativeArray, NativeList, or NativeHashMap allocations. Persistent runtime memory owned by DRS is requested through VaultBufferHandle IDs: BufferID.DrsState, BufferID.ResolutionScaleState, and BufferID.ResolutionScaleTelemetry. DRS also caches metadata for external read-only source BufferID.ShinobuScalabilityState / ScalabilityStateDTO.GlobalQualityWeight but does not allocate or create that buffer. If the external source is absent, DRS holds cached/default quality rather than polling a concrete producer. The editor oscilloscope owns managed arrays under UNITY_EDITOR only; they are excluded from player hot paths.

POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.MainThreadPolicy: Tick only completes the stress job when already complete or during shutdown/forced cleanup; it does not arbitrary-block the render policy path.

SELF_AUDIT.COMPILE_GUARD: No DRS asmdef introduces a direct sibling-domain dependency. Runtime usings route through Hecton8.Core contracts/core registry, GlobalRegistry, SignalBus, Unity rendering APIs, and DataVault handles. Quality source reads from the vault contract first and uses cached/default fallback; shader-global polling and concrete Homeostasis quality polling have been removed from the DRS policy Tick.
SELF_AUDIT.THE_DEAR_LIE_CONFIRMATION: The fake is screen-space reconstruction: lower internal 3D resolution, stable pixel-grid commits, mip-bias reduction, post-process fade, and TAA/FSR sharpen globals. Naive full-resolution rendering is GPU O(W*H) fill every frame; DRS reduces that to O((scale^2)*W*H) GPU fill plus O(1) CPU policy math. No physics or world simulation is added.
